title: HERO DUEL
oneLiner: Two masked heroes battle across a comic-book Waterloo arena in a fast one-screen showdown.
mechanics: Player one is a gadget hero; player two is a powerhouse hero.
Move, jump, and strike with A or B to knock back your rival.
Waterloo street hazards briefly appear and can stun either fighter.
A shrinking arena and constant round timer prevent stalling; first to two knockouts wins.
lose: Lose the round when your health reaches zero; lose the match after two round defeats.
scoring: Score points for landing attacks, collecting a street-sign bonus, and winning rounds.
